mapper.select: SELECT operation_id,space_id,workspace_id,file_id,kind,source_path,target_path,expected_revision,parent_version_id,source_version_id, version_id,asset_id,object_key,source_object_key,size_bytes,sha256 FROM pf.file_tree_restore_item WHERE operation_id=#{operation} ORDER BY source_path COLLATE "C"

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_mutation_intent m WHERE m.operation_id=#{operation} AND m.kind='RESTORE_TREE' AND m.entry_count=(SELECT count(*) FROM pf.file_tree_restore_item i JOIN pf.file_entry f ON f.id=i.file_id AND f.space_id=i.space_id AND f.workspace_id=i.workspace_id WHERE i.operation_id=m.operation_id AND f.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND f.deletion_operation_id=m.source_deletion_operation_id AND f.revision=i.expected_revision AND f.relative_path=i.source_path AND f.current_version_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM i.parent_version_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_entry occupied WHERE occupied.space_id=m.space_id AND occupied.workspace_id=m.workspace_id AND occupied.deleted_at IS NULL AND(occupied.relative_path=m.target_path OR left(occupied.relative_path,length(m.target_path)+1)=m.target_path||'/')) AND(m.target_parent_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_entry p WHERE p.id=m.target_parent_id AND p.space_id=m.space_id AND p.workspace_id=m.workspace_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.revision=m.target_parent_revision AND p.kind='DIRECTORY')))
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.file_entry f SET relative_path=i.target_path,parent_path=regexp_replace(i.target_path,'(^|/)[^/]+$',''),name=regexp_replace(i.target_path,'^.*/',''), current_version_id=i.version_id,collection_state='CONFIRMED',observed_bytes=i.size_bytes,observed_sha256=i.sha256, deleted_at=NULL,deletion_operation_id=NULL,retain_until=NULL,revision=f.revision+1 FROM pf.file_tree_restore_item i WHERE i.operation_id=#{command.operation.id} AND f.id=i.file_id AND f.space_id=i.space_id AND f.workspace_id=i.workspace_id AND f.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND f.revision=i.expected_revision

UPDATE pf.asset_object a SET status='AVAILABLE',revision=a.revision+1 FROM pf.file_tree_restore_item i WHERE i.operation_id=#{command.operation.id} AND i.kind='FILE' AND a.id=i.asset_id AND a.space_id=i.space_id AND a.version_id=i.version_id AND a.status='STAGING' AND a.sha256=i.sha256 AND a.size_bytes=i.size_bytes
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.asset_reference(space_id,asset_id,file_version_id) SELECT space_id,asset_id,version_id FROM pf.file_tree_restore_item WHERE operation_id=#{command.operation.id} AND kind='FILE'

INSERT INTO pf.file_version_origin(space_id,workspace_id,file_id,version_id,source_version_id,restore_operation_id) SELECT space_id,workspace_id,file_id,version_id,source_version_id,operation_id FROM pf.file_tree_restore_item WHERE operation_id=#{command.operation.id} AND kind='FILE'
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.space_storage s SET reserved_bytes=s.reserved_bytes-r.bytes,committed_bytes=s.committed_bytes+r.bytes,version=s.version+1 FROM pf.file_tree_reservation r WHERE r.operation_id=#{operation} AND r.space_id=s.space_id AND r.status='RESERVED' AND s.reserved_bytes>=r.bytes
UPDATE pf.file_tree_reservation SET status='SETTLED',revision=revision+1 WHERE operation_id=#{operation} AND status='RESERVED'

UPDATE pf.space_storage s SET reserved_bytes=s.reserved_bytes-r.bytes,version=s.version+1 FROM pf.file_tree_reservation r WHERE r.operation_id=#{operation} AND r.space_id=s.space_id AND r.status='RESERVED' AND s.reserved_bytes>=r.bytes
UPDATE pf.file_tree_reservation SET status='RELEASED',revision=revision+1 WHERE operation_id=#{operation} AND status='RESERVED'

UPDATE pf.asset_object a SET status='TOMBSTONED',revision=a.revision+1 FROM pf.file_tree_restore_item i WHERE i.operation_id=#{operation} AND a.id=i.asset_id AND a.space_id=i.space_id AND a.status='STAGING'
mapper.select: SELECT upload_id,operation_id,space_id,workspace_id,file_id,source_version_id,source_path,source_missing,manifest_json,manifest_hash,target_parent_id,target_parent_revision FROM pf.file_restore_upload WHERE upload_id=#{upload}

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_restore_upload r JOIN pf.upload_session u ON u.id=r.upload_id JOIN pf.file_entry f ON f.id=r.file_id AND f.space_id=r.space_id AND f.workspace_id=r.workspace_id WHERE r.upload_id=#{upload} AND f.revision=u.expected_revision AND f.current_version_id=u.base_version_id AND f.relative_path=r.source_path AND (r.source_missing=(f.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR f.collection_state='MISSING')) AND(r.source_missing OR f.collection_state='CONFIRMED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_entry occupied WHERE occupied.space_id=r.space_id AND occupied.workspace_id=r.workspace_id AND occupied.deleted_at IS NULL AND occupied.relative_path=u.relative_path AND occupied.id<>r.file_id) AND(r.target_parent_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_entry p WHERE p.id=r.target_parent_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.revision=r.target_parent_revision AND p.space_id=r.space_id AND p.workspace_id=r.workspace_id AND p.kind='DIRECTORY')))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.file_mutation_intent(operation_id,space_id,workspace_id,actor_id,request_id,request_hash,kind,root_file_id,source_path,target_path, expected_revision,manifest_json,manifest_hash,entry_count,source_version_id,target_parent_id,target_parent_revision) SELECT r.operation_id,r.space_id,r.workspace_id,u.actor_id,u.request_id,u.request_hash,'RESTORE_FILE',r.file_id,r.source_path,u.relative_path, u.expected_revision,r.manifest_json,r.manifest_hash,1,r.source_version_id,r.target_parent_id,r.target_parent_revision FROM pf.file_restore_upload r JOIN pf.upload_session u ON u.id=r.upload_id WHERE r.upload_id=#{upload}

INSERT INTO pf.file_version_origin(space_id,workspace_id,file_id,version_id,source_version_id,restore_operation_id) SELECT r.space_id,r.workspace_id,r.file_id,u.version_id,r.source_version_id,#{operation} FROM pf.file_restore_upload r JOIN pf.upload_session u ON u.id=r.upload_id WHERE r.upload_id=#{upload}
mapper.select: SELECT kind,root_file_id,source_path,target_path,manifest_json,manifest_hash,parent_operation_id FROM pf.file_mutation_intent WHERE operation_id=#{operation}

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_mutation_intent m WHERE m.operation_id=#{operation} AND m.entry_count=(SELECT count(*) FROM pf.file_mutation_item i JOIN pf.file_entry f ON f.space_id=i.space_id AND f.workspace_id=i.workspace_id AND f.id=i.file_id WHERE i.operation_id=m.operation_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.revision=i.expected_revision AND f.relative_path=i.source_path AND f.collection_state='CONFIRMED' AND f.current_version_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM i.version_id) AND(m.kind<>'MOVE' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_entry f WHERE f.space_id=m.space_id AND f.workspace_id=m.workspace_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND(f.relative_path=m.target_path OR left(f.relative_path,length(m.target_path)+1)=m.target_path||'/'))) AND(m.target_parent_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_entry p WHERE p.id=m.target_parent_id AND p.space_id=m.space_id AND p.workspace_id=m.workspace_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.revision=m.target_parent_revision AND p.kind='DIRECTORY' AND p.collection_state='CONFIRMED')))
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.file_entry f SET relative_path=i.target_path,parent_path=regexp_replace(i.target_path,'(^|/)[^/]+$',''), name=regexp_replace(i.target_path,'^.*/',''),revision=f.revision+1 FROM pf.file_mutation_item i WHERE i.operation_id=#{command.operation.id} AND i.space_id=f.space_id AND i.workspace_id=f.workspace_id AND i.file_id=f.id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.relative_path=i.source_path AND f.revision=i.expected_revision

UPDATE pf.file_entry f SET deleted_at=clock_timestamp(),deletion_operation_id=#{command.operation.id}, retain_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 days',revision=f.revision+1 FROM pf.file_mutation_item i WHERE i.operation_id=#{command.operation.id} AND i.space_id=f.space_id AND i.workspace_id=f.workspace_id AND i.file_id=f.id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.relative_path=i.source_path AND f.revision=i.expected_revision
mapper.select: SELECT pf.queue_file_delete_cleanup(#{parent},#{child},#{command},#{request})

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_mutation_intent c JOIN pf.file_operation p ON p.id=c.parent_operation_id AND p.status='COMMITTED' JOIN pf.file_runner_receipt r ON r.command_id=p.command_id AND r.result_state='MUTATED' WHERE c.operation_id=#{operation} AND c.kind='DELETE_CLEANUP' AND (r.stop_text::jsonb->>'execStopped')::boolean AND (r.stop_text::jsonb->>'callbacksStopped')::boolean)

UPDATE pf.upload_session SET status='VERIFIED',transfer_owner=NULL,transfer_until=NULL,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='UPLOADING' AND transfer_owner=#{owner} AND transfer_until>clock_timestamp()
UPDATE pf.upload_session SET status='VERIFYING',transfer_owner=NULL,transfer_until=NULL,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='UPLOADING' AND transfer_owner=#{owner}

mapper.update: UPDATE pf.workspace_file_lease SET operation_id=#{row.id},owner_id=#{owner},fence=#{fence},lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds',status='ACTIVE' WHERE space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{row.workspaceId} AND status='FREE' AND fence=#{fence}-1

UPDATE pf.file_entry SET current_version_id=#{row.versionId},collection_state='CONFIRMED',observed_sha256=#{row.sha256},observed_bytes=#{row.sizeBytes},revision=revision+1, relative_path=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_restore_upload WHERE upload_id=#{row.id}) THEN #{row.relativePath} ELSE relative_path END, parent_path=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_restore_upload WHERE upload_id=#{row.id}) THEN regexp_replace(#{row.relativePath},'(^|/)[^/]+$','') ELSE parent_path END, name=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_restore_upload WHERE upload_id=#{row.id}) THEN regexp_replace(#{row.relativePath},'^.*/','') ELSE name END, deleted_at=NULL,deletion_operation_id=NULL,retain_until=NULL WHERE id=#{row.fileId} AND space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{row.workspaceId} AND current_version_id=#{row.baseVersionId} AND revision=#{row.expectedRevision} AND current_version_id IS NULL AND revision=1

UPDATE pf.asset_object SET status='AVAILABLE',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{row.assetId} AND space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND version_id=#{row.versionId} AND sha256=#{row.sha256} AND size_bytes=#{row.sizeBytes} AND status='STAGING'
UPDATE pf.object_reservation SET status='COMMITTED',revision=revision+1 WHERE upload_id=#{row.id} AND space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND bytes=#{row.sizeBytes} AND status IN('RESERVED','RECONCILING')

UPDATE pf.object_reservation SET status='RELEASED',revision=revision+1 WHERE upload_id=#{row.id} AND space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND bytes=#{row.sizeBytes} AND status IN('RESERVED','RECONCILING')
UPDATE pf.space_storage SET reserved_bytes=reserved_bytes-#{row.sizeBytes},version=version+1 WHERE space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND reserved_bytes>=#{row.sizeBytes}
mapper.select: SELECT w.space_id,w.id AS workspace_id,w.actor_id,coalesce(d.parent_path,'') AS parent_path,d.cursor_path AS cursor,d.epoch,d.directory_stamp AS stamp FROM pf.workspace w LEFT JOIN pf.file_scan_directory d ON d.space_id=w.space_id AND d.workspace_id=w.id JOIN pf.app_user u ON u.id=w.actor_id AND u.status='ACTIVE' JOIN pf.membership m ON m.space_id=w.space_id AND m.user_id=w.actor_id AND m.status='ACTIVE' WHERE w.state='READY' AND(d.last_scanned_at IS NULL OR d.cursor_path IS NOT NULL OR d.last_scanned_at<clock_timestamp()-interval '30 seconds') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_operation o WHERE o.workspace_id=w.id AND o.status IN('PENDING','CLAIMED','RUNNING','UNKNOWN')) ORDER BY d.last_scanned_at NULLS FIRST,w.id,d.parent_path LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.file_scan_directory(space_id,workspace_id,parent_path,epoch) VALUES(#{space},#{workspace},#{parent},#{epoch}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT d.space_id,d.workspace_id,w.actor_id,d.parent_path,d.cursor_path AS cursor,d.epoch,d.directory_stamp AS stamp FROM pf.file_scan_directory d JOIN pf.workspace w ON w.space_id=d.space_id AND w.id=d.workspace_id WHERE d.space_id=#{space} AND d.workspace_id=#{workspace} AND d.parent_path=#{parent} FOR UPDATE OF d
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_operation WHERE workspace_id=#{workspace} AND status IN('PENDING','CLAIMED','RUNNING','UNKNOWN'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.file_entry(id,space_id,workspace_id,relative_path,parent_path,name,kind,collection_state,observed_bytes,observed_sha256,last_scan_epoch) VALUES(#{id},#{command.operation.spaceId},#{command.operation.workspaceId},#{entry.path},#{command.operation.scanParent},regexp_replace(#{entry.path},'^.*/',''),#{entry.kind},'CONFIRMED''PENDING',#{entry.bytes},#{entry.sha256},#{command.operation.scanEpoch}) ON CONFLICT(space_id,workspace_id,relative_path) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL DO UPDATE SET observed_bytes=EXCLUDED.observed_bytes,observed_sha256=EXCLUDED.observed_sha256,last_scan_epoch=EXCLUDED.last_scan_epoch,collection_state=CASE WHEN file_entry.kind<>EXCLUDED.kind THEN 'BLOCKED' WHEN file_entry.kind='DIRECTORY' THEN 'CONFIRMED' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_version v WHERE v.space_id=file_entry.space_id AND v.id=file_entry.current_version_id AND v.sha256=EXCLUDED.observed_sha256 AND v.size_bytes=EXCLUDED.observed_bytes) THEN 'CONFIRMED' WHEN file_entry.current_version_id IS NULL THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'CHANGED' END,revision=file_entry.revision+CASE WHEN file_entry.collection_state IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN file_entry.kind<>EXCLUDED.kind THEN 'BLOCKED' WHEN file_entry.kind='DIRECTORY' THEN 'CONFIRMED' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_version v WHERE v.space_id=file_entry.space_id AND v.id=file_entry.current_version_id AND v.sha256=EXCLUDED.observed_sha256 AND v.size_bytes=EXCLUDED.observed_bytes) THEN 'CONFIRMED' WHEN file_entry.current_version_id IS NULL THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'CHANGED' END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.file_entry SET collection_state='CHANGED',observed_bytes=NULL,observed_sha256=NULL,revision=revision+1 WHERE space_id=#{command.operation.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{command.operation.workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND parent_path=#{command.operation.scanParent} AND last_scan_epoch IS DISTINCT FROM #{command.operation.scanEpoch} AND collection_state<>'CHANGED'

UPDATE pf.file_scan_directory SET cursor_path=#{page.next},epoch=#{epoch},directory_stamp=NULL#{page.stamp},last_scanned_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE space_id=#{command.operation.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{command.operation.workspaceId} AND parent_path=#{command.operation.scanParent} AND epoch=#{command.operation.scanEpoch} AND cursor_path IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{command.operation.scanCursor}

UPDATE pf.file_scan_directory SET cursor_path=NULL,epoch=#{epoch},directory_stamp=NULL,last_scanned_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE space_id=#{command.operation.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{command.operation.workspaceId} AND parent_path=#{command.operation.scanParent} AND epoch=#{command.operation.scanEpoch}
mapper.sql: u.expires_at<clock_timestamp() AND u.status IN('CREATED','VERIFIED','ABORTED') AND a.status IN('STAGING','TOMBSTONED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.asset_reference r WHERE r.space_id=a.space_id AND r.asset_id=a.id) AND(u.operation_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_operation o WHERE o.id=u.operation_id AND o.status='FAILED' AND o.effect_state='CONFIRMED')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_version v WHERE v.space_id=a.space_id AND v.asset_id=a.id)
mapper.select: SELECT u.id FROM pf.upload_session u JOIN pf.asset_object a ON a.space_id=u.space_id AND a.id=u.asset_id WHERE ORDER BY u.expires_at,u.id LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.upload_session u JOIN pf.asset_object a ON a.space_id=u.space_id AND a.id=u.asset_id WHERE u.id=#{id} AND )
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.upload_session SET status='ABORTED',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN('CREATED','VERIFIED','ABORTED')
UPDATE pf.asset_object SET status='TOMBSTONED',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{row.assetId} AND space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND status IN('STAGING','TOMBSTONED')
UPDATE pf.asset_object SET status='PURGED',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{row.assetId} AND space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND status='TOMBSTONED'
UPDATE pf.upload_session SET status='EXPIRED',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{row.id} AND space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND status='ABORTED'
